title: Digit Count in Range
description: Count the occurrences of a digit d in the range [0, n].
pseudocode:
1. Convert n to string digits
2. For each position, calculate contribution of digit d
3. Sum results and return

steps.note: Initialize variables for n=13, d=1. Convert 13 to [1, 3].
Processing tens place: multiplier=10, digit=1. Count adds (13/10)*1 + min(max(13%10 - 1 + 1, 0), 1) = 1 + 1 = 2.
Processing units place: multiplier=1, digit=1. Count adds (13/1)*1 + min(max(13%1 - 1 + 1, 0), 1) = 13/10 * 1 + 1 = 1 + 1 = 2.
Total count for digit 1 in range [0, 13] is 6 (1, 10, 11, 12, 13).
